ਸ੍ਰਉਨਤ ਸੰਗ ਭਰਿਯੋ ਪਰਿਯੋ ਦੇਖਿ; ਦਯਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਕਰੁਨਾਨਿਧਿ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ॥
sraunat sang bhariyo pariyo dekh; dayaa upajee karunaanidh ke man |

aae tahaa naavan in kayo |

tomar |

soaoo aae tthaadt bhayo tahaa; jarr yaeh sir na nivaae kai |

balibhadr kupiyo kamaan kar; lai maariyo tih dhaae kai |2383|

sabh rikh utth tthaadte tab bhe |

eik rikh tho tin ais uchaariyo |

buraa keeo haladhar dij maariyo |2384|

chhatree ko poot tho kop bhare; tih naas kayo, binatee sun leejai |

tthaadt bhe utth kai rikh, so jarr; baitth rahio, kahio saach pateejai |
” Balram, making this request, stood up and said, “I am telling the truth that this fool sat uselessly near me

baat vahai kareeai sang chhatran; jaa ke kee jag bheetar jeejai |

ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਬਧੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕੀਯੋ ਸੁ; ਅਬੈ ਮੋਰੀ ਭੂਲ ਛਿਮਾਪਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨੩੮੬॥
taahee te mai badh taa ko keeyo su; abai moree bhool chhimaapan keejai |2386|

ਰਿਖ ਬਾਚ ਹਲੀ ਸੋ ॥
rikh baach halee so |
Speech of the sages addressed to Balram:

mil sabh rikhin halee so bhaakhee |

kahai sayaam tih dij kee saakhee |
ਇਹ ਬਾਲਕ ਥਾਪਿ ਰੋਹ ਹਰੋ ॥
eih baalak thaap roh haro |
ਬਹੁਰੋ ਜਾਇ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭ ਕਰੋ ॥੨੩੮੭॥
bahuro jaae teerath sabh karo |2387|
All the sages, bearing testimony to the killing of the Brahmin, said to Balram, “O boy! now you removing all your anger, go to all the pilgrim-stations for a bath.”2387.
ਕਬਿਯੋ ਬਾਚ ॥
kabiyo baach |
Speech of the poet:
ਚਾਰੋ ਈ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖਾਗ੍ਰਜ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ; ਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਬਰੁ ਐਸੋ ਦੀਯੋ ॥
chaaro ee bed mukhaagraj hoe hai; taa sut ko bar aiso deeyo |
He (Balram) gave such a boon to the son of that Brahmin that all the four Vedas be retained in his memory
ਸੋਊ ਐਸੇ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਲਗਿਯੋ ਰਟਨੇ; ਮਨੋ ਤਾਤ ਸੋਊ ਤਿਹ ਫੇਰਿ ਜੀਯੋ ॥
soaoo aise puraan lagiyo rattane; mano taat soaoo tih fer jeeyo |
He began to recite the Puranas etc. in such a way that a appeared his father had been resuscritated

chit aanand kai sabh hoo rikh ke man; kau, jih kee sam kaun beeyo |

sir nayaae tinai sukh paae ke teerathan sayaam su raameh paidd leeyo |2388|

gangeh sindh jahaa miliyo; prithamai balibhadr tahaa chal nrahaayo |
Balram, in the first place, took a bath in the Ganges

fer tribainee mai kai isanaan; dai daan balee hariduaar sidhaayo |

nrahaae tahaa pun badree kidaar; gayo at hee man mai sukh paayo |

aaur gano keh lau jag ke; sabh teerath kai tih tthaureh aayo |2389|

fer naimakhvaaran meh aayo |

teerath kahiyo mai sabh hee kare |

bidh poorab jiau tum uchare |2390|

halee baach rikhin so |

ab aaeis jo hoe su karo |

tab mil rikhin ihai jeea dhaaro |

halee baach |

kahaa tthaur tih satru kee, kaho rikhin ke raaj |
ਮੋਹਿ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਉ; ਤਾਹਿ ਹਨੋ ਅਉ ਆਜੁ ॥੨੩੯੩॥

tab ik rikh nai jaae bataayo |

ਸੁਨਤ ਬਚਨ ਤਬ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਰਿਸਾਯੋ ॥
sunat bachan tab satru risaayo |

haath gaagano yaa par aayo |

jih sam tthaur beer nahee beeo |2395|

doaoo bhatt abhran jiau gaajai |

doaoo beer krodh so larai |2398|

bahut gadaa tan lage na jaanai |

mukh te, maareh maar bakhaanai |

reejh reejh doaoo bhatt larai |2400|

judh bhayo bahuto tih tthaa; tab moosal kau musalee joo sanbhaariyo |
ਕੈ ਬਲ ਹਾਥਨ ਦੋਊਨ ਕੇ ਕਬਿ ਸ੍ਯਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਤਕਿ ਘਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਯੋ ॥
kai bal haathan doaoon ke kab sayaam kahai tak ghaeh prahaarayo |
After the continuation of war for a long time, Balram held his huge mace and powerfully struck it with both the hands on the enemy

laagat ghaa ih kai mar gayo ar; antak ke fun dhaam sidhaariyo |
